item.title: 🟠 Srsly Risky Biz: OpenAI's Kazoo-Grade Spying Incident
item.description:
Why this matters: Service impact is possible — verify vendor status before troubleshooting internally.
Tom Uren and Amberleigh Jack talk about the weird bugging incident at OpenAI. It doesn’t look at all like it was normal state-backed espionage, but there are still  good reasons  the frontier labs should ensure that their crown jewels are safe. They also discuss how cybercriminals are rapidly evolving their use of AI. The technology and harnesses available are getting better and the criminals are also discovering business models where they can sit back while AI automates most of the work. This episode is also available on YouTube.

Source: Risky Business News  |  Severity: Important  |  Age: 13h
